title: Exclusive RefMut Mapping
goal: Use `RefMut::map` to mutate a field nested inside a RefCell.
hints: `RefMut::map` requires an exclusive RefMut guard created by borrow_mut().
The projection closure must return a mutable reference &mut u16.
explanation: `RefMut::map` consumes a `RefMut<Config>` and projects it into a `RefMut<u16>`. `borrow()` returns `Ref<Config>`, which is incompatible with `RefMut::map` (`E0308`). Returning `&c.port` yields a shared reference `&u16`, breaking the closure signature requirement of returning `&mut u16` (`E0308`). `get_mut()` fails because `c` is a shared reference `&RefCell<Config>`, requiring exclusive access (`E0596`).
